classification: BUILD_CACHE_FLAG_ACCUMULATION; tester isolated clean build first, durable build-policy engineering only if necessary
rules: use fresh attempt output/build cache, preserve original polluted cache/logs
native subprocess argv array, shell=False; never POSIX shlex Windows argv
absolute response token @D:/.../file.rsp as one argv item, cwd is its build tree
all target flags retained, -fno-fast-math/-ffp-contract=off never relaxed
CMAKE_NINJA_FORCE_RESPONSE_FILE alone only moves in/libs in current rule, not repeated LINK_FLAGS
do not patch global installed SDK or delete global caches
if clean target still exceeds wrapper bound, use target-scoped full driver rsp with all effective flags/objects/libs and explicit build dependencies
rspEncoding: UTF8 no BOM, LF, driver response quoting; forward-slash canonical paths, embedded double-quotes/backslashes encoded for the consuming driver; native argv serialization is separate
receipts: known user vs SDK flags baseline and repetition count
compiler/linker SHA, immutable source/generated inputs/object SHA
new unique ELF path/hash/BuildId and package entry relation
compilerHistoricalConclusion: a1 reported fast compilation is attempt-local; no proof excluding every compiler issue or explaining old CPU-zero waits
noAutomaticBlock: independently built correct G9rx package is not blocked by this main-tree cache failure
